description: Test suite for the Promotional Scheme feature in ERPNext, including setup, testing promotional scheme creation, modification, and deletion, as well as interactions with sales orders and pricing rules.

classes.name: TestPromotionalScheme
classes.description: Unit test class for Promotional Scheme functionalities, including creation, update, and deletion tests.

methods.name: test_promotional_scheme

methods.name: test_promotional_scheme_without_applicable_for
